lines.text: Felix the fox was glued to his shiny video game tablet from sunrise to sunset!
Tap, swipe, click! His eyes were red, his neck was stiff, and his paws were crampy!
Come chase autumn leaves and climb the mossy rocks! called his woodland friends!
Just five more minutes! mumbled Felix, staring at colorful digital pixels on the glass.
Mama Fox announced screen time is over, placed the tablet in the basket, and led him outside!
The fresh pine breeze woke his senses, and the squishy grass tickled his furry paws!
They built a giant leaf fort, caught dandelion seeds, and raced up the sunny hill!
Screen time is fun in small doses, but real outdoor adventures make your body strong and happy!
